note: Catalogued component tokens that the browser throws away — declared in @layer components, overridden on a real element by something outside it. `entries` is DEBT: every line is a defect someone still owes, and the list may only SHRINK — the gate fails on anything new. `intentional` is the other kind: an arrangement a human has judged correct, keyed identically and carrying the reason, so the gate keeps watching it while the list of owed work stays honest. Keyed on the ARRANGEMENT (property/token/losing rule/winning rule) and never on a frame, an element or a measured value — one broken promise is one entry however many screens render it. `seenOn` is where to go and look.
tracked:
gh#822 opened this list at 32. gh#824 took the first four to judgement and closed it at 25 + 2 intentional, each verdict re-measured at 1280px by setting the token on :root to 37px and re-reading the element.
  • --control-radius on .ui-button (3 entries) — DELETED. The declaration had been inert since #124 gave Button `rounded-[var(--button-radius)]`, and it was also untrue: it named var(--radius) (6px) while every button painted var(--radius-md) (3.70828px). NOT chained — the two resolve 6px vs 3.70px, so a chain would have put 2.3px of corner on every button. The knob stays catalogued; it is live on Input and the control trigger (6px -> 37px).
  • --control-label-font-size on .ui-label (1 entry) — CHAINED. --form-label-font-size now defaults to var(--control-label-font-size, var(--text-sm)). Free: both sides are 0.875rem (base.css declares --text-sm AS var(--font-size-sm)). FormField labels 14px -> 37px, and the resting 14px did not move.
  • --conversations-item-radius (1 entry) — CHAINED, through --button-radius on the row itself, the same move the ruled Calendar day button already makes. The rail's rows moved 3.70828px -> 6px: 6px is what the token has advertised all along, and the sidebar rows this rail's defaults were drawn from are 5px.
  • --topbar-icon-size (2 entries) — INTENTIONAL, and gh#824's fourth row is REFUSED. The token is live: 37px on :root moves every .ui-topbar-item > svg but one, and all four glyphs in the icon slot. The one is AppShell's mobile-nav hamburger, whose 20px comes from --app-shell-mobile-nav-icon-size, a catalogued token that says in its own description it is bigger on purpose. See the `intentional` map below and the call site in app-shell.tsx.
The remaining 25 are untouched and still owed. ~14 of them are call-site choices in docs examples (--avatar-size <- .size-*, --card-title-font-size <- .text-*), which is a different question; several others are arguably deliberate the way the topbar pair turned out to be and need the same measured verdict before anyone 'fixes' them.

intentional.height · --topbar-icon-size · .ui-topbar: gh#824 — NOT a broken promise, re-measured. This is the AppShell mobile-nav hamburger and only it. `--topbar-icon-size: 37px` on :root at 1280px moves every other `.ui-topbar-item > svg` 16px -> 37px (2 on layout-topbar-item, 1 on layout-topbar) and all 4 glyphs in the `.ui-topbar-item-icon` slot, so the bar's knob is live and paints exactly the 16px it claims. The 20px the issue measured is --app-shell-mobile-nav-icon-size, a second catalogued token whose own description says it is bigger ON PURPOSE: the hamburger is the only navigation affordance a phone has. One cell overriding the bar's step through a documented knob is the knob working. Reason also written beside the call site in src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx.
